scope: Only the supplied homepage. Independent static-export Next.js project. Hardcoded frontend data; no backend or API calls. Existing application files were not edited.

known_differences: The original font is unidentified; local Roboto Condensed and Kalam are approximations.
AI-rebuilt transparent bulb differs in face, pose and shading.
Some decorative gradients, cloud transitions, borders and curves are approximations.
Original brand lettering and other clipped artwork retain reference resolution; rendering at higher DPR does not recover missing native detail.

architecture_review: The stylesheet is long because it includes the entire illustrated homepage, responsive layouts and isolated local dialogs. Its responsibility is still one standalone page; no unrelated abstractions or project changes were introduced.
